agent.reasons: The entity's industry is crypto. That counts as virtual currency, a restricted industry under 5.2, so the case must be escalated. The licence is not verified, so the 5.3 exception does not apply. The registry filing (2025-06-19) is more than 12 months old at the 2026-10-27 review, which would require requesting documents under 3.5, but escalation is the more severe outcome under 2.1. Ownership is complete: Iris Holdings owns 46%, so Nora Eriksen holds about 34.96% indirectly, and she is identified and verified. The control person, Rosa Ishikawa, is identified and verified. There are no sanctions, PEP or geography issues.
